   ## ReName - Addon for Streamers & Video Creators (Fake / Hide Names in UI)
   
   > ReName  
   > Streaming Privacy Addon
   > 
   > 
   > 
   > **DOWNLOAD**
   > 
   > **[Download Me](https://mega.nz/#!pVl2kYwY!xP-utNvHq7RHYHQJHBo0VHnysfD9pISijrSsqah-5Qc)**
   > _Current Version: 1.3.301 - Last Updated 22/8/16 - Patch 7.0.3_
   > 
   > **What is ReName**
   > 
   > Some of you may remember my older addon, StreamGuard. I stopped working on that for various reasons, and later picked it up again but didn't really release it publicly for more various reasons. Anyway, once again I don't really work on it much anymore since I don't do any activities that'd require it, so I'm going to once again put it here for everyone to use. It does have a lot of new features since the last time the general public had it, including many of the asked for features.
   >
> The addon allows you to hide the name of yourself, and any other player from the in-game UI (client side). It's a good way to hide or change your name when recording videos for YouTube or streaming to Twitch or similar sites, and you don't want people to know your character name, such as when piloting/boosting or recording exploit/exploration videos, using bots or you just want some plain ol' privacy.
   > 
   > I haven't really tested it much since Legion hit, so some of it may be broken. Let me know if it is.
   > 
   > Also, I'm not a programmer so the code is pretty awful, but it works.
   > 
   > **How Does it Work?**
   > 
   > It's a normal WoW addon. You put it into your interface folder like any other addon. Unlocked Lua is not required. From there, you select your fake character and guild name, and add any players you also want hidden and give them their names.
   > 
   > Because it is a normal addon that uses in-game Lua and nothing is, there is a 99.
99% chance that you'll never get banned (just for this). At worst, if Blizzard doesn't like it they will just break functionality.
   > 
   > **Where Does It Hide Names?  
   > **
   > 
   >     + Player Frame
   >     + Target Frames
   >     + Party Frames
   >     + Raid Frames
   >     + Compact Raid Frames
   >     + Raid Buttons
   >     + Tooltips
   >     + Battleground Score Page
   >     + Arena Score Page
   >     + Removes Your Battletag from Friends page
   >     + Guild Roster
   >     + Guild News
   >     + Recount
   >     + Mail
   >     + Gossip Options
   >     + Quest Text
   >     + Ready Checks
   >     + Character Drop Down Menu
   >     + Linked Profession panels
   >     + Boss loot
   >     + Loot rolls
   >     + Chat frame
   >     + Garrison Zone name
   >     + Probably more that I forgot
   > 
   > 
   > 
   > **What Are The Limitations?**
   > 
   > It doesn't hide _everything_ . You can only access so much without memory editing.
It doesn't hide the name above players heads (which you should just turn off). It doesn't hide it from chat bubbles (kinda, a bit broken atm)/nameplates (it did but it broke and I don't play enough to fix it, can also be turned off). I may have also missed other parts of the interface where it may show your actual character name. Let me know if I did and I will add it if I get time.

# Streamer Mode

This addon is mainly targeted at streamers to prevent being sniped in open world pvp.

It will obfuscate or hide player names in the default blizzard interface:

* TargetFrame and Target of Target names are replaced with class names
* nameplate player names are replaced with class names
* Tooltip when mouseover a player is replaced with class names
* Names above ANY unit (npc or player) is obfuscated and each letter is replaced with the Ω-Symbol (Omega)

Thanks to Hydra this addon was developed, as he was being sniped a lot.

# Streamer mode "hide my name" function now requires 750 wins

[Blizzard Official](https://www.reddit.com/r/Competitiveoverwatch/?f=flair_name%3A%22Blizzard%20Official%20%3Aflair-blizzard%3A%22)

<https://preview.redd.it/ttge7r3qzrzd1.png?width=1794&format=png&auto=webp&s=033a801a7d4ce7839f13316045a5c4d9a7120e74>

I just noticed that access to the "hide my name" function of streamer mode now requires completing the “Tenacious Hero” lifetime challenge (750 wins in Overwatch 2 (OW1 doesn't count)).

This requirement isn't quite as steep as Blizzard first announced: In [Defense Matrix (Aug 19)](https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24107756/defense-matrix-removing-cheaters-from-overwatch-2/) and [Season 13 patch notes (Oct 21)](https://siege.

# UnitName

[Sign In to Save Save](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.
com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_UnitName%3Fcollections%3Dsave&uselang=en&metadata=collections-save-button "Sign In to Save") [Edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_UnitName%3Fveaction%3Dedit&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article)

* [History](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/API_UnitName?action=history)
* [Purge](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/API_UnitName?action=purge)
* Talk (6)

|HinaSalute |Automated updating of API pages at this location, to reflect patch changes, has ceased from 10.1.7 onwards. |
| --- | --- |

Returns the name and realm of the unit.

```
name, realm = UnitName(unit)
            = UnitFullName(unit)
            = UnitNameUnmodified(unit)
```

## Arguments [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_UnitName%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D1&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

    unit

...

* The unit name will change if the unit is under the effects of [[ Lifegiving Seed ]](/wiki/Lifegiving_Seed "Lifegiving Seed") or a similar effect, but `UnitNameUnmodified()` is unaffected by this.

## Example [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_UnitName%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D4&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]

* Prints your character's name.

```
/ dump UnitName ( "player" ) -- "Leeroy", nil
```

* Prints the name and realm of your target (if different).

```
/ dump UnitName ( "target" ) -- "Thegnome", "DarkmoonFaire"
```

* `UnitFullName()` is equivalent with `UnitName()` except it will always return `realm` if used with the "player" UnitId.

```
/ dump UnitFullName ( "player" ) -- "Leeroy", "MoonGuard" 
 / dump UnitFullName ( "target" ) -- "Leeroy", nil
```
